summary: Iteration 21 verifies the full Superbet (superbet.gr) pre-match integration. Backend pytest iter21: 12/12 passed in 96s. Frontend unit tests (picks.js settlement for home_corners_over_4.5 / away_fouls_under_11.5 / home_shots_over_12.5 / away_sot_under_4.5 / saves_over_6.5 and needsDetail): 18/18 passed. Frontend UI (Specific Bets): 86 superbet.gr hrefs on live_af_1550151, 0 forbidden-book hrefs; link hosts are strictly superbet.gr + bet365.gr + bwin.gr + novibet.gr + elabet.gr; 4 unpriced-market notes still rendered on live_af_1575188 (Union Berlin vs Dortmund); snapshot warning banner present. Quota safety: a one-off `supervisorctl restart backend` left Superbet at callsThisMonth=2 (unchanged), fixtures=76 and GET /api/value-matches populated (count=119, source=live) — snapshot was loaded from odds_cache slug='superbet' and respected the 6h TTL (no new 'superbet: N fixtures' log line emitted).

evidence.picks_js_unit_tests: 18/18 passed (per-team fouls/saves/corners/shots/sot and saves_over_X plus needsDetail=true for all six)

specific_bets_live_af_1575188_union_dort.Fouls: 0/14 priced — note 'No bookmaker prices this market for this fixture'

critical_code_review_comments: superbet_odds.py streams the 550MB JSON with ijson in a worker thread (asyncio.to_thread) so the event loop never blocks; refresh is guarded by a 6h TTL, a 120/month ceiling and an asyncio.Lock — a backend restart correctly reuses the DB snapshot (slug='superbet') and did NOT trigger a download in this test (callsThisMonth stayed at 2).

The {line:g} formatting of pick ids plus explicit 3-way acceptance of whole-number lines (iter20 fix) continues to hold: team-corner lines render cleanly on all 4 fixtures tested; no 'corners_over_5.0' leaks.

_pick_id drops whole-number lines on 'goals'/'fh_goals' (2-way markets at Superbet are push on the line) but keeps them on the 3-way stat markets — this is correct and prevents fake push rows from leaking into Goals/First-Half panels.

bookmakers.js maps Superbet -> https://www.superbet.gr/stoixima/podosfairo and no non-.gr operator has a link; the UI verification found zero links to Betano/Unibet/William Hill/BetVictor/Pinnacle/Marathonbet/1xBet/Betfair.

picks.js settleStatus correctly handles the five new patterns via two regex rows (`^(cards|corners|fouls|offsides)_(over|under)_X$` + `^(home|away)_(fouls|saves|corners|shots|sot)_(over|under)_X$` + `^saves_(over|under)_X$`); needsDetail excludes these picks from score-only settlement; 18/18 unit tests pass.
LION tickets regenerated to include Superbet legs (53 across 22 tickets); parlay odds always <= product(legs)+0.01; max legs=6; every leg bookmaker is Greek-licensed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (18/18 unit + UI verified on live_af_1550151 and live_af_1575188)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Superbet snapshot slug='superbet' in odds_cache; refresh is credit-expensive (one of only 120/month calls + 20s download + 1-3 min parse). NEVER call superbet_odds.refresh(force=True). A plain supervisorctl restart is safe — the module loads from Mongo and the 6h TTL keeps it stable. Canonical fixtures for Fouls/Offsides/Saves/Shots coverage: live_af_1550151 (Frosinone-Sassuolo), live_af_1563200 (Norwich-Southampton), live_af_1552785 (Le Mans-Toulouse). For the 'far-out, still unpriced' regression use live_af_1575188. Note that per-team SoT ('home_sot_*') exists in the backend path but only renders when Superbet actually quotes it, which it does not for these three fixtures. VITE_BACKEND_URL (not REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) is the Vite env var; the tests read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from the shell with a fallback to the preview URL.
